test_cases.title: Customers list shows its columns, links and status filter options
acs: DERIVED: Customers list has the columns QAL Number, Name, Organisation, Details, Participants and Contracts and a status filter - /Contracts Admin/CustomerList.aspx (probe 2026-11-02)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/CustomerList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Customers and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the column headings of the table.
steps.expected: The columns QAL Number, Name, Organisation, Details, Participants and Contracts are shown.

steps.action: Read the links above the table.
steps.expected: The links Create Customer, Review Pending Customer Updates, Review Pending Participant Updates and Review Pending Orders are shown. Do not click them.

steps.action: Open the status dropdown.
steps.expected: The options Active Only, Inactive Only and All are listed.

steps.action: Look for the Filter button.
steps.expected: The Filter button is visible.

test_cases.title: Filtering the Customers list by Inactive Only and All keeps the page
acs: DERIVED: The status filter reloads the Customers list - /Contracts Admin/CustomerList.aspx (probe 2026-11-02)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
The number of rows after filtering is not asserted.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/CustomerList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Customers and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Select Inactive Only in the status dropdown and click Filter.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Customers and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Read the column headings of the table.
steps.expected: The columns QAL Number, Name, Organisation, Details, Participants and Contracts are still shown.

steps.action: Select All in the status dropdown and click Filter.
steps.expected: The page reloads with the h1 Customers and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Look at the table.
steps.expected: At least one customer row is shown.

test_cases.title: Review Pending Customer Updates link opens its page from Customers
acs: DERIVED: Customers links to Review Pending Customer Updates - /Contracts Admin/CustomerList.aspx and ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
Only the heading is asserted; nothing on the review page is selected.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/CustomerList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The page loads, the h1 reads Customers and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Look for the Review Pending Customer Updates link.
steps.expected: The link is visible.

steps.action: Click the Review Pending Customer Updates link.
steps.expected: The browser opens the review page.

steps.action: Read the main heading of the page.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Customer Updates.

steps.action: Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown and the h1 is still Review Pending Customer Updates.
